title: Turquoise-haired Cosmic Women
description: A vertical five-panel comic-style artwork depicting the same stylized woman with long flowing turquoise hair in different poses and mystical settings. She appears as a powerful sorceress holding glowing orbs and runes, floating above surreal purple lavender fields, interacting with floating faces, small figures, and cosmic symbols under a gray sky with planets.
